anti_schematic_rules: Do not rotate the six core actors mechanically.
A chapter/episode belongs to the actor with the largest decision uncertainty or deepest contradiction in that scene.
No actor is guaranteed a scene merely to maintain symmetry.
At least one ordinary-life or non-conversion scene must appear in each major part, even if it scores lower on historical leverage.
Secondary-ring viewpoints are allowed when they reveal a system-level transformation that the six core cannot see from inside.
The ensemble final scene cannot explain the previous ten years to the reader.
